site.title: Studio Rose Hallgren
site.heading: Studio Rose Hallgren
site.description: Rose Hallgren is a multidisciplinary architect and designer in Stockholm, working between traditional craft and contemporary architecture.
site.intro:
I am a multidisciplinary architect and designer based in Stockholm. My work explores the intersection of traditional craft techniques and contemporary architectural practice, with a particular focus on weaving and ceramics as mediums for spatial design.

I am co-founder of Fanfaluca Collective, an architecture collective spanning Stockholm and Barcelona, and C.O.U.A. (The Collective of Unexpected Architecture), a studio for unexpected art and design. I am also part of Svartljus, a Stockholm-based lighting collective creating bespoke light sculptures and immersive experiences for museums, events, and festivals. I am also part of Kulturföreningen PLX.

My studio is at Åsögatan 122 in Stockholm, shared with SMASH and collaborator Jonas Johansson.
